headline: KCR @ STL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is KCR 4.19 at STL 4.99, with a projected total of 9.18. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward STL: KCR moved -0.49 runs while STL moved +0.17, changing the projected margin by -0.66 runs. The projected total fell -0.32, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -5.8%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Kyle Leahy has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 2.2 ER over the last 5 starts. Batter research is strongest for Bobby Witt Jr., Iván Herrera, Jordan Walker, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Lane Thomas, Victor Scott II because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
